create_YZBlock: create a YZBlock instance with pairwise Y and Z linear layers for self-attention on token distributions
run_YZBlock_forward: run YZBlock forward pass to compute attention-weighted token predictions from input tensor and source mask
create_YZFormer: create a YZFormer model stacking multiple YZBlock layers with configurable nonlinearity for sequence modeling
run_YZFormer_forward: run YZFormer forward pass to transform one-hot encoded sequences through stacked YZBlock layers and return attention maps
review_YZBlock_attention: review the YZBlock forward method to understand how inner product attention is computed and masked
